name: Robbyant (Ant Group)
summary:
Robbyant is an Ant Group company developing embodied AI and robotics technology. Its work spans spatial perception, action models, reward models and the tools needed to connect AI decision-making with physical interaction. It works with intelligent-hardware partners to turn these capabilities into robot applications.

The company identifies home assistance, elderly care and medical support among its intended application areas. Its approach emphasizes the intelligence layer behind robots as well as integrated solutions, combining an understanding of the surrounding environment with the ability to plan and execute actions. The goal is to make robotic assistance adaptable to everyday human needs.
